usage.callShape: GET https://blockrun.ai/api/v1/usstock/history/{SYMBOL}?from={epochSeconds}&to={epochSeconds} — e.g. /usstock/history/AAPL?from=1778373520&to=1780965520. x402 USDC on Base, no API key.
usage.outputShape: body.bars[] (array of OHLC daily bars: {t: epochSec, o, h, l, c, v}); body.symbol, body.resolution ("D"), body.source ("pyth"), body.category. NOTE: v (volume) is 0 from the Pyth source.
quirks: MANDATORY query param: `from` (Unix epoch SECONDS). Calling /usstock/history/AAPL with no query params returns HTTP 400 {error: 'Missing or invalid `from` (Unix epoch seconds)'} AND STILL CHARGES you $0.001 — always include from before paying.
Also pass `to` (epoch seconds) to bound the range; with both set it returns 200 daily OHLC bars.
Symbol is a path segment, not a query param (e.g. /usstock/history/AAPL).
Resolution is daily ('D'); volume field `v` is always 0 (Pyth-sourced).
usage.guide: Call GET https://blockrun.ai/api/v1/usstock/history/{SYMBOL} with REQUIRED query params from and to as Unix epoch SECONDS (e.g. ?from=1778373520&to=1780965520). Omitting `from` returns a 400 but still charges you, so always include it. Pay via x402 USDC on Base — no API key. Read the OHLC history from body.bars[], each bar being {t (epoch sec), o, h, l, c, v}; note volume v is 0. Symbol goes in the path, not the query string.
